declarations.name: AuiMentionInput
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI MentionInput: `<aui-mention-input>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Supplementary hint; never replaces the label.

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.description: Trigger characters with their async providers: { char, provider(query, { signal, trigger }), label?, minChars? }.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name; the hidden input carries the JSON value.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Empty text is invalid; shows the required indicator.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Focusable and submitted, not editable; no suggestions.

inputs.name: multiline
inputs.description: true: a textarea; false: a single-line input with the combobox role.

inputs.name: maxLength
inputs.description: Maximum length in code points (validated, not truncated).

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: debounce
inputs.description: Milliseconds between the last keystroke and the provider call (0 to 5000).

inputs.name: maxSuggestions
inputs.description: Most suggestions shown at once (1 to 50).

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: valueInput
outputs.description: The text or mentions changed: { value, validity }.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: Committed: a mention was inserted, or focus left with a changed value.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Combobox with a listbox popup (list autocomplete). The single-line field is role=combobox with aria-expanded; the textarea keeps its native textbox role (ARIA does not allow combobox on textarea) and exposes aria-autocomplete, aria-controls, and aria-activedescendant.

limitations: Mentions are not highlighted inside the field (a native textarea cannot style ranges); they are plain text with tokens in the value.
Inserting a suggestion replaces the field value programmatically, so the browser's undo history does not include it.
Queries stop at whitespace: multi-word labels are found by their first word.
